name: English
title: Set up your connection
subtitle: Three steps, about two minutes.
step_install_body: Hiddify is free and open source.
step_add_body: With the app installed, tap the button below. Hiddify opens with your profile ready to save.
manual_body: Copy the link, open Hiddify, tap + in the top right, then tap Clipboard.
qr_body: In Hiddify on your phone, tap + then Scan QR, and point it at this code.
step_connect_body: Tap the big button in the middle.
step_done_body: Green means you are connected. Tap the same button again to stop.

ios.label: iPhone
ios.install: Install Hiddify from the App Store.

android.label: Android
android.install: Install Hiddify from Google Play, or download it directly if the store is unavailable.
